title: APPEAL/1/2026 — GANPAT RAM vs. RAJASTHAN GRAMIN BANK
text:
Court of the Presiding Officer
Debts Recovery Tribunal, Jaipur
Item No. 24
Case No. APPEAL/1/2026 IN OA/259/2023
GANPAT RAM Vs RAJASTHAN GRAMIN BANK
Date: 17.04.2026.
The DRT, Jaipur is currently holding additional charge of DRT
Allahabad and DRT Lucknow, and is taking up matters pertaining to those
tribunals through VC.
Further, the Tribunal is engaged in the conduct of the Lok Adalat
scheduled to be held on 08.05.2026. Therefore, upon the request of the
DRT Bar Association, Jaipur, only fresh and urgent matters involving
immediate threat of possession and auction notice are being taken up till
the Lok Adalat.
Accordingly, re-notified this matter for the same purpose on 15.05.2026.
Court Master
Debts Recovery Tribunal, Jaipur
